name: Kalyani Cast-Tec
why: Management outlook: So, in this slide, you can find the guidance for '26-'27.
Latest quarter Mar 2026: Good (sales +29% YoY, profit +100% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 89% to 81% of sales)
Vendor-qualification / long-term-agreement language on the concall
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit
Working capital stretching - debtor days 69 to 80, inventory days 32 to 17 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up

order_book: At present, we have got for this year the order book of around INR133 crores, and more and more containers, basically we are negotiating more orders.
And basically, the order book is almost 50% comprises the innovations we did in last 7 months, 8 months, 9 months, and 50% is the normal containers.
guidance: So, in this slide, you can find the guidance for '26-'27.
So, we expect very soon this will be around INR170 crores.
capex: In fact, normal 20-feet, 40-feet containers, we have increased the capacity.
Rewari facility has got around 7,000 TEUs capacity.
risks: With respect to basically due to various uncertainties, this half yearly has not started as per our expectations, and due to war and so many uncertainties into the system, supply chain got disturbed everywhere.
Despite geopolitical uncertainties and volatility into the global business, we continue to remain strong order book, demonstrating business resilience purely due to innovation in this sector.
focus: The reason why I asked this question is that many international players, such as Maersk and Alstom, are looking to diversify from China, you know.
What is the asset turn that you're targeting going ahead?
But if you can give a colour around what are the key pillars to this the target turnover or revenue which we are targeting to achieve in broad categories and associated risk with that?
quals: So, make some more investment increasing the capacity at Shivlakha plant so that we can immediately be qualified as a brownfield company having the 25,000 TEUs capacity.
